results.comment:
Known issue: the same code can be applied twice.

Error: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator:  getByTestId('discount')
Expected: "−€1.45"
Received: "−€2.90"
Timeout:  1000ms

defects.title: A discount code can be applied more than once
defects.description: Applying WELCOME10 twice takes 20% off instead of 10%. The automated test "A discount code applies only once" fails because of it; each CI run links its failure here.

defects.title: The cart scrolls sideways on a 320 px wide screen
defects.description: On a 320 px wide screen the cart table needs about 380 px, so the page scrolls sideways (WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow).
